limitations: Whole main text/five main figures consumed. Table1P10pixels clipped in supplied manuscript; S1all330cells consumed. SupplementalPDFall20pages text and scientificplates1-9pixels read; methods/referencepages10-20not separately pixel-inspected. S2/S3/S4/S6 held but unread; raw GEO294227/294226 not accessed or reanalysed.

Table1 usesNM_016652.6 R267C/R267H/R301G, packets NM_001278628.2 R106C/R106H/R140G. Constant483bp/161aaoffset suggests isoform difference but this is not a sequence-verified mapping. ZebrafishR105H/R139G are yet another orthologue numbering, not humanpacketR106H/R140G.

Abstract says ten de novo butTable1P3/P9inheritance NA. Source seizure text8/9 differsTable1eightpositive andtwoNA(P2/P7); no seizures cannot be inferred for NA. P3/P9development limited due death, no formal IDassessment forP9. P5primary onset not individually measured; source congenital cohort language does not substitute birthOFC.

P5skeletalrow22normal but row27mildscoliosis; P8GIrow19no but row27chronicconstipation; detailedpositive retained. P2cerebellar hypoplasia does not specifically establish vermis. P6tetraparesia not necessarily tetraplegia; P9partialsyndactyly not specifically cutaneous; P10prominenteyes not measuredproptosis. All negative height/dysphagia observations are time-specific.

Only two R267H fibroblast casesP4/P5 compared with two controls, many cellular assays stated data not shown. Nonsignificant proliferation/DNA-damage/apoptosis outcomes do not establish normal function. No usable endogenous CRNKL1 antibody; HEKoverexpression n2 blots cannot quantify endogenous mutant stability.
